en: A vintage sepia-toned photograph of a large steel truss bridge spanning a wide river. The bridge rests on massive stone piers and dominates the composition from the lower left to the upper right. Trees and low buildings line the far riverbank. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in a serif font that identifies the bridge as "Daugavpils-Grīvas tilts." The overall style and wear suggest an early–20th-century postcard.
